recently_checked.reason: Multi-SSD KV-cache offloading uses stable co-activation patterns to distribute concurrently accessed KV entries across devices and aggregate storage bandwidth.

recently_checked.title: Tutti: Making SSD-Backed KV Cache Practical for Long-Context LLM Serving
recently_checked.reason: Primary arXiv material was checked; the paper is already indexed in the KV-cache offload lineage.

recently_checked.title: KVDrive: A Holistic Multi-Tier KV Cache Management System for Long-Context LLM Inference
recently_checked.reason: Coordinates attention-aware GPU KV reuse, pipelined selection/fetch/compute, and HBM-DRAM-SSD sparse block movement for long-context decoding.

recently_checked.title: RetroInfer: A Vector Storage Engine for Scalable Long-Context LLM Inference
recently_checked.reason: Treats CPU-resident KV cache as attention-aware vector storage, retrieves only query-relevant KV to GPU, and overlaps retrieval, transfer, and attention with a GPU-CPU buffer manager.

recently_checked.title: ParisKV: Fast and Drift-Robust KV-Cache Retrieval for Long-Context LLMs
recently_checked.reason: Keeps full-precision KV in CPU DRAM while GPU-resident fixed-direction and 4-bit key summaries perform drift-robust coarse-to-fine Top-k retrieval; selected KV is fetched on demand through UVA.

recently_checked.title: ScoutAttention: Efficient KV Cache Offloading via Layer-Ahead CPU Pre-computation for LLM Inference
recently_checked.reason: Splits sparse attention between GPU-resident and CPU-resident KV blocks, starts CPU attention one Transformer layer early using a predicted next-layer query, and periodically recalls hot blocks asynchronously to hide CPU compute and PCIe latency.

recently_checked.title: SPICE: Speculative Prefetching with Low-Rank Expert Surrogates and Heterogeneous Orchestration for MoE Inference Acceleration
recently_checked.reason: Predicts experts several layers ahead, uses a resident shared expert plus low-rank surrogates for low-confidence misses, and schedules exact residual work between CPU execution and GPU weight fetch to reduce PCIe stalls.
